title: olivares.ai/appliance-source-bundle/v1
description: source-bundle.json, which the appliance build writes beside the images for the corresponding source bundle: the bundle's archive basename, byte size and SHA-256, the count of regular files it holds including the root SOURCES.json, and the SHA-256 of the exact root SOURCES.json bytes. A bundle too large for one file is written as numbered parts, listed in parts with each part's size and SHA-256; size and sha256 are then the joined stream's.

parts.description: Present when the bundle is written as parts: the files NAME.001, NAME.002, ... in order, whose bytes joined are the archive that size and sha256 describe. Absent when the bundle is the one file NAME.
